category_title: Students with low online continuity and infrequent LMS participation
minimal_context: The student is participating in a face-to-face communicative practice activity in the language classroom where they must discuss their weekend plans.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's practice our speaking. Please tell me about your plans for the weekend in the target language, and then we can have a discussion about it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will go to the park. I will watch a movie.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you tell me more about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The movie is good. I like movies.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to ask me a question or add more details so we can have a conversation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know how to say more. I just share the same plans as my partner. That is all.
